ghi_chu: Lời mô tả trang phục cho hình lớn Pháp tướng (tools/hinh_lon/ve.mjs). Dáng theo món áo: proto/src/dashboard/trangPhuc.ts.
Bậc theo cảnh giới: 1 Luyện Khí, 2 Trúc Cơ và Kết Đan, 3 Nguyên Anh trở lên. Màu vẽ sẵn theo trang phục, không nhuộm theo hệ.

bac.1: a simple, modest version: plain sturdy materials and few ornaments (a beginner of the Qi Refining realm)
bac.2: a refined version: finer materials, tasteful embroidery and metal fittings, a jade or silver ornament (an established cultivator of the Foundation Establishment realm)
bac.3: a majestic version: ornate luxurious materials, intricate luminous embroidery or faintly glowing engraved runes, ribbons or cloth drifting in the air (a powerful elder of the Nascent Soul realm and above)

dang.bo_y: a commoner's rough hemp robe and trousers in earthy browns and faded greens, a straw-rope belt, cloth shoes
dang.thu_sinh: a scholar's long robe in soft white and ink blue with wide sleeves, a scholar's sash, a writing brush tucked at the belt
dang.dao_bao: a Taoist cultivator's long robe in deep blue with a white inner collar and a black sash
dang.vo_phuc: a martial artist's short jacket and baggy trousers in deep red and black, leather bracers, a wide black sash
dang.da_hanh: a night-stalker outfit in black and charcoal: a hood, a cloth mask over nose and mouth, fitted tunic, arm wraps, soft boots
dang.tang_y: a monk's robe in saffron and earthy brown with a draped kasaya over one shoulder and a string of prayer beads
dang.ao_long: a heavy fur-lined cloak in dark brown and grey over a warm quilted tunic, a thick fur collar, sturdy boots
dang.tien_y: an ethereal fairy robe of layered translucent silk in white and soft pastel tones with long floating ribbon sleeves and sash streamers
dang.phap_y: a mage's ceremonial robe in deep purple and gold with embroidered mystic symbols (bagua trigrams, stars), a high collar and broad sleeves
dang.giap_da: light leather war armor: a hardened brown leather breastplate with stitched straps over a dark tunic, leather bracers, wrapped leg guards
dang.giap_phien: lamellar war armor: rows of bronze and iron plates laced over a padded robe, round chest mirror plates, armored shoulder guards
dang.giap_lan: scale war armor: a coat of small overlapping steel scales over a dark robe, scaled shoulder guards, a leather belt, armored tassets
dang.giap_tuong: a general's war armor: gilded plates and lion-face fittings over a crimson battle robe, dragon-head pauldrons, a flowing cape

nghe.tu_tran: a dark navy-blue long robe with white cloud-pattern trim along the hem and cuffs, black sash belt, dark trousers and boots
nghe.tu_dan: a blue robe with a long brown leather apron over it, black sash belt, cloth-wrapped forearms, simple sandals
nghe.sat_thu: a dark blue hooded assassin outfit: hood covering the head, black cloth mask over nose and mouth, fitted tunic, black arm wraps, black sash, dark trousers and black boots
nghe.tu_ren: a sleeveless dark top showing bare muscular arms, a long brown leather blacksmith apron, black sash, brown leather bracers, baggy dark trousers and brown leather boots
nghe.tu_duoc: a light blue herbalist robe with a cream inner collar, black sash with small pouches, straw sandals
nghe.tu_kim_tien: a rich dark blue long coat with gold trim and a gold belt, a thick white fur collar, dark boots
